command: set -euo pipefail; printf '%s\n' '=== python modules ==='; for py in python3 /usr/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3; do if command -v "$py" >/dev/null 2>&1 || test -x "$py"; then echo "--- $py"; "$py" --version 2>&1 || true; "$py" -c 'import importlib.util; print("skidl", importlib.util.find_spec("skidl")); print("pcbnew", importlib.util.find_spec("pcbnew"))' 2>&1 || true; "$py" -m pip show skidl 2>&1 | sed -n '1,40p' || true; fi; done
